name: NH Foods Ltd.
summary: NH Foods Ltd., headquartered in Osaka, Japan, is a global company specializing in meat processing and packaging, with operations both domestically and internationally. Founded in 1942, the organization was originally known as Nippon Meat Packers Inc. before rebranding to NH Foods Ltd. in June 2014. Its core operations are divided into several segments. The Processed Foods Business division manufactures and distributes a range of hams and sausages, notably under the SCHAU ESSEN and Utsukushi-no-Kuni labels. This segment also supplies deli items and other prepared foods, featuring brands like Chuka Meisai and Ishigama Kobo. The Fresh Meats Business division oversees the entire supply chain for fresh meat products, encompassing animal production and rearing, slaughtering, processing, distribution, and ultimate sale. Furthermore, the Affiliated Business division broadens the company's portfolio to include marine and dairy products. This segment is responsible for the sourcing, processing, manufacturing, and distribution of seafood, offering items such as seafood salads, Chinese jellyfish, various delicacies, and mackerels to a diverse clientele including supermarkets and restaurants. In the dairy sector, it provides cheese products under the ROLF brand to clients like bakeries, confectionery manufacturers, and convenience store chains, alongside yogurt and probiotic beverages marketed under the Luna brand. Beyond these primary areas, NH Foods Ltd. is also involved in supplying freeze-dried foods, meat extracts, and health foods. The company extends its operations to include various corporate support services, such as information technology, accounting, human resources system development, personnel training, welfare programs, and architectural design. Additionally, it participates in trading and sponsors sports activities.
